finding: No material blocker found within the protocol-only preparation scope.
qualifications: Signature validity is not independent proof of physical termination, current host boot, held durable lease, journal/kernel observations or reservation release.
Real issuer/key custody, current-lease/durable-terminal/kernel integration and capacity-release transaction semantics remain unimplemented acceptance gates.
Frozen Python objects and private tokens prevent ordinary API construction/mutation; they are not a security boundary against arbitrary privileged code already running inside the same Python process.

The independent focused run exercised30 selected synthetic authentication, canonical parsing, unavailable issuer and actual temporary-file receipt cases; the owner full113-test receipt remains separate and immutable.
Native runtime/profile sources were not edited or re-executed by this review. No cloud calls, keys with operational authority, DB mutations, real analysis or capacity actions occurred.
reviewed_boundaries: Actual physical issuer is unconditionally unavailable: issue_termination_packet refuses before reading a lease, kernel witness or signing key, regardless of caller-shaped data.

Pure signing authenticates assertions only; synthetic tests use ephemeral keys and explicit synthetic-software-test scope. The verifier has an explicit default-off, bounded, independently configured pinned issuer/key/material registry and one trust scope.

Verification compares the entire independently retained ClosedExecutionBinding before domain-separated Ed25519 verification. The separate pinned issuer scope binds worker/material/source-policy identity; per-job profile, journal epoch and closed fence remain in the full binding.
All header/claim fields are signed. There is no packet-supplied public key, authorization bit, algorithm choice or implicit synthetic-to-operator promotion.

Wire input must be exact bytes of1–16384 bytes. Duplicate keys, non-ASCII or noncanonical serialization, floats/nonfinite constants, unknown fields, coercible bool/int ambiguity, invalid sequence/time order and correlated cleanup mismatches are rejected.

VerifiedTerminationPacket authenticates claims only. Its launch/release properties are alwaysfalse and science remains not_independently_verified. No controller fence closure, DB capacity release, route registration or process execution is implemented.

Receipt storage requires an existing absolute canonical private owner-controlled directory, anchored directory FD, regular private single-link file, stable path/inode identity and exact bytes. First create is O_EXCL; retries retain only identical execution+fence bytes; conflicts and unsafe symlink/hardlink/FIFO/public/oversize/partial targets are never replaced.

File and directory fsync precede a successful retention return. A crash leaving partial data causes an explicit fail-closed receipt conflict; the protocol does not silently reconstruct or overwrite it.
